catalog_and_calculation_counts.interpretation: 284 are calculation rows, variants and resource lines, not 284 source jobs. The 9 outside-active records are a subset of the 151 active source records and must remain visible as out-of-scope references rather than be silently deleted.

confirmed_decisions.decision: Apply 40% once to the total pre-markup order calculation after summing selected line items. Never apply 40% to individual operations, shop groups, posts, bundles or material lines.
Keep quote basis and planned costs separate. Calculate order profit and margin from the final order quote and total planned costs.
Every operation must have a physical quantity basis, calculation logic, unit rate, planned cost basis and explanatory financial source. Market price alone is not proof of internal profitability.
Operator accompaniment is a separate calculation position for each CNC post. It must not be hidden inside the machine tariff or duplicated in another labor line.
confirmed_decisions.overlap_rule: Overlapping time intervals of the same employee across posts are counted once; different employees are summed.

confirmed_decisions.decision: Keep programming preparation as separate lines, outside machine cutting tariffs. Calculate from total unique contour length divided by the relevant preparation productivity. Do not multiply programming volume by the number of identical parts in a batch.

operations.name: Управляющая программа для лазерной резки профильного металлопроката

confirmed_decisions.decision: Do not use work 139 for metal cutting. Use work 144. Until actual measurements are available, use 25 cuts per hour and 79.64 RUB per single cut.
Keep work 35 only as a preliminary aggregate estimate. The working labor rate is 1810 RUB per person-hour, not per crew-hour. Detailed operations replace the aggregate line for the same scope.
confirmed_decisions.example: 2 installers * 2 hours = 4 person-hours; 4 * 1810 = 7240 RUB before global order markup.

confirmed_decisions.decision: Remove the bundled 2300 RUB/m2 rate from product manufacturing. Foundation/base works belong to the construction estimate. Installation of steel frames, joists and deck boards is performed by the installation crew and must be decomposed into simple operations in a separate site-installation estimate.

Exclude the bundled work 175 completely. The manufacturing estimate includes only the individually specified formwork production operations; remaining site works belong to a separate construction estimate.

Work 34 (actual installation person-hours) and work 35 (preliminary aggregate) are fallback/alternative representations, not additive to detailed installation operations. Work 49 (20% general installation) exists in the previous source mapping but was not recovered as a confirmed user decision; keep it disabled or clearly marked as a legacy alternative until explicitly reviewed. Never let it duplicate detailed installation.

Source units replace application units. If a unit changes, show a warning until the next configuration save; do not change the price and do not perform implicit unit conversion. Store source formula and source parameters separately; display the original text and substituted formula as an explanation, but do not recalculate the original Excel formula in the UI.
confirmed_decisions.warning_text: Единица измерения изменена на базовую. Требуется проверка стоимости и корректности расчёта

confirmed_decisions.decision: Keep base price and current price separately. Manual price editing changes only current price and shows the individual-price note. Reset restores the original base price, formula and note.

Keep full numeric precision internally and display 2 decimals. Price value 0 and text "по запросу" mean no price and must display as absent. For order quantity, an empty value means not entered while numeric 0 means a known zero volume.
